what_was_built: A reading beside c2-path, not the C rung: the same build with the 12 answers a2-path broke alone in the fit (104 rows, each answer through the first token a2-path's own answer changes, asked for the state they had in the original model). The 17 repaired answers' same contexts are read, not fitted. All 18 corrections were written. Each is 2.1% to 9.1% of a2-path's change of that matrix.

answers_on_its_own.how: The corrected model answers the 60 questions of the overlap and round one's 28 on its own, greedy, on GPU0. The same judge reads the original, a2-path's and this model's answer.
answers_on_its_own.complete_answers: Complete answers, this run beside a2-path: of the 12 correct answers a2-path broke, 3 (a2-path 0); of the 17 wrong answers it repaired, 7 (17); of the 13 wrong answers it did not repair, 4 (0); of the 18 correct answers it kept, 11 (18). In all 11 of the 30 that were wrong and 14 of the 30 that were correct (a2-path 17 and 18). Round one, outside the fit: 4 of its 21 failures and 3 of its 7 correct answers (a2-path 7 and 3).
answers_on_its_own.the_calculation_the_edit_aimed_at: By the judge's field for the available energy, of the 30 answers that subtracted the descent: still subtracting it 2, leaving it out 0, stating the right available energy 16 (a2-path 1, 3 and 17). Of the 30 that were correct: with the field 'descent subtracted' 3, stating the right energy 17 (a2-path 0 and 18). The field reads the stated number only: under a2-path Astra's reading of the text found four correct answers whose first error was the descent subtracted where the field says 'other' or 'missing', so the field undercounts and the two models are compared on the field alone. These answers have not been read one by one.
answers_on_its_own.texts: 4 of the 60 answers of the overlap are a2-path's answer token for token. 17 leave a2-path's answer within their first 20 steps; the others leave it later. Against a2-path, 21 of the 88 answers went from complete to not complete and 8 the other way.
answers_on_its_own.the_fourth_token: At the fourth token, where every answer still has the original's whole history, this model prefers ' calculation' over ' compact' by 0.21 to 0.37 of a score more than the original (median 0.28); a2-path by 0.24 to 0.45 (median 0.34). The shift is smaller than a2-path's in 58 of the 60 answers and about the same in the four groups (medians 0.27, 0.28, 0.27, 0.3). 31 answers leave the original's text at that token (a2-path 40; 31 of them under both).

own_traces.how: As a2-path: each of the 60 answers of this model recorded with the turns of its own computation, laid on the axis by the computation alone, read against the original correct and wrong patterns as turns and as states. 0 is the wrong pattern, 1 the correct one; sideways and travelled are in gaps.
own_traces.beside_a2_path: Over places 142 to 313 the answers that were wrong lie 0.95 of the way to the correct pattern (states; a2-path 0.79) and 1.16 gaps to the side (1.04); the correct answers travelled 1.24 gaps (1.27); the two groups are 0.42 as far apart as before (0.54). By group, where each answer's own trace lies (median): the 17 repaired 0.99, the 13 not repaired 0.87, the 12 damaged 0.89, the 18 kept 0.87.

construction_readings.note: Readings of the build on the given text, against the state of the same rows in a2-path's model read once before any correction. They are not a test.
construction_readings.what_the_fit_did: On the given text the damaged answers' rows returned most of the way at every matrix: along a2-path's action they keep 0.01 to 0.05 of it, and in distance they end 0.08 to 0.22 of that action away from their original state (0.07 to 0.21 as far as a2-path left them). The repaired answers' same opening steps went with them, keeping 0.07 to 0.14: their inputs are the same (the part of a damaged row outside what the repaired rows span is 0.0% to 0.8% per matrix at the median, at most 4.4%). The repaired answers' later steps (125 rows, of the three answers whose first change comes after step 15) keep 0.98 to 1.01.
construction_readings.distance_to_a2_paths_state: apart_from_a2_paths_state_after_rms = sqrt(apart_from_original_after_rms^2 + a2_paths_action_rms^2 (1 - 2 a2_paths_action_kept_after)), Astra's formula, per set and matrix.

prediction_vs_result.building: As predicted. The protected rows end nearer their original state at every matrix and most of a2-path's action on them is gone (0.01 to 0.05 left). On the repaired answers' same steps it is gone to about the same degree (0.07 to 0.14 left), and on their later steps it is kept (0.98 to 1.01). The declaration named two answers for the later steps; the reading includes three rows of a third, whose first change is at step 18.
prediction_vs_result.fourth_token: As predicted in direction, far less in size than the build suggested. The preference moves less than under a2-path in 58 of the 60 answers (median 0.28 against 0.34) and 31 answers leave their text there against a2-path's 40. The rows ended 0.08 to 0.22 of a2-path's action from their original state; the preference moved back much less than that.
prediction_vs_result.damaged_answers: Not as predicted. 3 of the 12 damaged answers are complete, not most of them, and 14 of all 30 correct answers against a2-path's 18. Their first step apart from the original: [3, 3, 3, 3, 11, 15, 15, 15, 15, 93, 107, 305] (under a2-path [3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 11, 15, 15, 15, 15]).
prediction_vs_result.wrong_answers: As predicted. 28 of 30 no longer subtract the descent on the judge's field, and 11 are complete, more than b2-path's 4 and fewer than a2-path's 17: 7 of the 17 a2-path repaired and 4 of the 13 it had not.
prediction_vs_result.traces: The answers that were wrong lie 0.95 of the way along the gap over places 142 to 313 (predicted: more than half; a2-path 0.79); the correct answers travelled 1.24 gaps (predicted: less than a2-path's 1.27).
prediction_vs_result.round_one: Not as predicted. 4 of round one's 7 correct answers are broken, against a2-path's 4.
prediction_vs_result.would_weaken_it: The hypothesis's weakening result did not occur. The added assumption's did not occur in the form declared: none of the 17 repaired answers has the field 'descent subtracted', though 10 are no longer complete and 6 no longer state the right available energy. The first construction result occurred in part: the protected rows returned most of the way at all 18 matrices and 9 of the 12 damaged answers still leave their text by step 15 (4 at the fourth token, where a2-path had 7). The declaration read that outcome as the action reaching the opening through the question's positions. That reading is not established (Astra's review): the rows did not return entirely, only the directions of the states were compared, and a preference between two tokens is not proportional to how far rows moved. The second did not: 0.993 to 0.999 of a2-path's change of each matrix is kept.

failures_only.note: Every answer with its fields in the original model, after a2-path and after this run; its role by a2-path's record; the first step at which it writes another token than the original, under a2-path and under this run, and than a2-path's own answer; its fourth token; and for the 60 of the overlap where its own trace lies between the two patterns over places 142 to 313.

what_this_changes: Returning the opening rows most of the way did not return the opening. With the damaged answers' rows brought back to 0.08 to 0.22 of a2-path's action from their original state at all 18 matrices on the given text, the fourth-token preference still moves 0.28 of a score at the median against a2-path's 0.34, and 31 answers leave their text there against 40. What carries the rest is not shown. The question's positions, which every run asked to keep and none kept, are a plausible route; so are what is left of the movement on these rows and the size of the state, which no target holds. A run that returns the question's positions would say.

Cancelling a2-path's action at the opening did not restore the answers it had broken (3 of 12) and cost repairs (7 of 17 stay complete), with a correction of 2.1% to 9.1% of a2-path's change. 29 of 88 answers changed completeness against a2-path and 4 of 60 texts are the same. Five models close to a2-path have now been read (three fractions of it and the two corrections); every one completes fewer answers than a2-path in both groups, and from 0.58 of its size on every one keeps the calculation repaired in at least 27 of the 30 answers on the judge's field. The count of complete answers separates a2-path from its neighbours; it does not yet separate one construction from another.

Protection by asking rows for their state has now failed three ways: the rows asked to stay in a2-path and b2-path moved, c2-path's two asks met on the same inputs, and the rows returned here did not bring the answers back. For the next round, what is kept has to include the question's positions and has to be kept by something stronger than an ask among other asks. D2 tries a measure of the change instead of an ask.

The reading along the gap does not go with complete answers. Over places 142 to 313 the answers that were wrong lie 0.95 of the way to the correct pattern here, with 11 of them complete; c2-path 0.87 with 12; a2-path 0.79 with 17; b2-path 0.63 with 4. It goes with the calculation the edit aims at, which is repaired in 27 to 30 of the 30 in all four. A trace that lies on the correct pattern where the two patterns diverge is what the edit asks for and what it gets; it has not been enough for the whole answer to be right.
By Astra's limit, this run does not show that a2-path's repair lives in the opening: the correction acts through the weights beyond its 104 rows, and the repairs it lost went with texts that changed.
